answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into resilient fruiting bodies, decentralized consensus grows through proof of symbiotic bond. At every network dawn, an identity kernel validates historical peer-staking trees rather than raw computing power. Forging multiple cloned nodes demands superlinear collateral growth, because each additional identity requires exponentially deeper stake bonds across unreproducible mutual histories. Like a complex sonnet where each stanza strictly constrains the next, illegitimate clones collapse under escalating economic weight.
